title: Family Intervention Strategies
learningGoal: Teach parents how structured interventions support behaviour, routines, and emotional development.
microLesson: Family interventions use predictable routines, positive reinforcement, and emotional coaching to improve behaviour. Small, consistent changes create long‑term improvements. Parents who use structured strategies help children feel secure and supported.
activity: Choose one intervention strategy (routine, praise, visual chart). Use it for two days and reflect on the outcome.
